title: Company
description: One company in the registry. A company's roles are listed only when climate.tier is 'core' or 'enabling' AND startup.status is 'in'. Sector and stage ids come from taxonomy.yml.

board.description: Board token on that ATS, exactly as it appears in the feed address (case matters on Ashby).

read.description: auto: the collector reads a feed. manual: a person reads the board. none: not read.

categories.description: Categories outside clean tech that fit the company (taxonomy.yml categories; decision 23). Clean tech is never listed here: it follows from a core or enabling climate tier. A company in any category is listed even when its tier is out.

reason.description: One line. Required for every tier except 'unscreened'.

basis.description: provisional: the supervisor's first pass from general knowledge, not checked against the company's site.

approved.description: True once Eric has approved the tier.

parent.description: The owning company, when this one is a subsidiary, division or joint venture. Null when independent.

last_raise.description: The latest equity round found: venture, growth or private equity.

ipo_year.description: Year the company listed publicly, including by SPAC merger.

startup.description: The startup test agreed 2026-11-24 (PLAN.md section 9): independent, under 4,000 people (about 25 percent tolerance), and at least one growth sign (founded within 15 years, an equity raise within 5 years, or public for under 5 years).

status.description: review: near a line, needs a figure or a decision.
